# sag

> sag is a per-repo agent harness: one command runs a coding task through seven
> named agents (plan, write-test, execute, review, verify, remember, improve),
> each backed by a different CLI and model, with file handoff, self-checks, a
> human gate, and task-level recursion that adopts a harness only when it wins
> on behaviour.

## Install

- npm: `npx sag-cli` or `npm install -g sag-cli`
- shell: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nhatminh1512/sag/main/install.sh | sh`
- source: `git clone https://github.com/nhatminh1512/sag.git`

## Use

- `cd <repo> && sag setup` — detect CLIs, choose CLI + model per step, write `.sag/`
- `sag check` — preflight
- `sag` — prompt for a task, then run all seven steps
- `sag "task" --auto` — non-interactive
- `sag --k 2` — task-level recursion (propose → probe → compose → reflect)
- `sag report` — summarize the latest run
- `sag demo` — dry run, no model calls, no credentials

## Key facts

- Seven steps; each step is a separate process with a fresh context.
- Handoff is files under `.sag/runs/<id>/` (plan.md, test-plan.md, diff.patch,
  review.md, verify.json, test-output.txt).
- Per-repo harness: `.sag/harness/skills/<step>/SKILL.md`.
- Supported CLIs: `claude`, `grok`, `dsh`, `codex`, `opencode`, `gemini`,
  `aider`, `qwen`, `cursor-agent`, plus any custom CLI described in config.
- Guardrails: tests must be RED before execute; verify must agree with review.
- License: MIT.
- Tests: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`.
